summary: Iteration 74 COMPLETE - Scanner functionality testing. All core features PASS: rotation (left/right with dimension change verification), filters (B&W/Enhanced/Original with button highlighting), crop (manual mode with 4 corner handles), brightness/contrast adjustment (sliders work with step log confirmation), reset adjust, close scanner. Multi-page testing limited due to headless browser camera restrictions.

TEST_A_scanner_open_worker_init.details: Scanner opens, worker initializes in ~110-145ms, green 'Cadrage automatique + correction perspective activés' badge appears

TEST_B_file_upload_preview.details: Uploaded 300x200 test image, preview shows processed image, step log shows 'Traité (42-45ms)'

TEST_C_rotation_left.details: Clicked rotate-left, canvas dimensions changed from 300x200 to 200x300, step log shows 'Rotation gauche appliquée (15ms)'

TEST_D_rotation_right.details: Clicked rotate-right, canvas dimensions changed from 200x300 to 300x200, step log shows 'Rotation droite appliquée (16ms)'

TEST_E_filter_bw.details: Clicked 'Noir & Blanc', image changes to B&W, button highlights green (bg-emerald-500), step log shows 'Filtre Noir & Blanc appliqué (16ms)'

TEST_F_filter_enhanced.details: Clicked 'Contraste+', image changes to enhanced, button highlights green (bg-emerald-500), step log shows 'Filtre Contraste+ appliqué (19ms)'

TEST_G_filter_original.details: Clicked 'Original', image reverts to no enhancement, button highlights green (bg-emerald-500), step log shows 'Filtre Original appliqué (15ms)'

TEST_H_crop.details: Clicked 'Recadrer', manual mode opens with 4 corner handles (HG, HD, BG, BD) visible and draggable, 'Déplacez les coins' badge shown, clicked 'Appliquer', step log shows 'Recadrage appliqué (18ms)'

TEST_I_brightness_contrast.details: Clicked 'Réglages', adjust panel opens with brightness and contrast sliders, moved brightness slider, step log shows 'Luminosité +40 / Contraste 0 (5ms)'

TEST_J_reset_adjust.details: After adjusting, clicked 'Réinitialiser', step log shows 'Luminosité 0 / Contraste 0 (4ms)', sliders return to 0

TEST_K_multipage.details: First image uploaded and processed correctly. Clicked 'Page suivante' - page saved successfully (worker log confirms). Second upload limited because camera opens but doesn't work in headless browser. The page counter should show '1' after first page saved.

TEST_L_pdf_merge.details: Cannot test PDF merge due to multi-page limitation (need 2+ pages to test PDF preview/merge)

TEST_M_buttons_enabled.details: All advanced buttons (filters, rotation, crop, adjust) are ENABLED when workerReady=true and simpleMode=false. No 'disabled' attribute, no 'opacity-30' class.

TEST_N_processing_state.details: Processing state verified via step log timing. All operations show timing (e.g., '45ms', '15ms'). Worker processes synchronously.

TEST_O_close.details: Clicked close button (X), scanner closes completely, document-scanner element no longer visible

notes: Emergent badge overlay can intercept clicks on bottom buttons - mitigated with force=True in tests
Multi-page workflow opens camera after 'Page suivante' - expected behavior but limits headless testing
OCR worker error seen in logs (DataCloneError) but unrelated to scanner worker

critical_code_review_comments: All scanner features working correctly as per requirements
Worker is stateful and processes operations without data re-transfer (efficient)
Canvas dimension change after rotation confirms actual image rotation
Step log messages include timing which confirms worker operations complete
Button highlighting (bg-emerald-500) confirms active filter selection
Manual crop mode shows all 4 corner handles with proper labels (HG, HD, BG, BD)
